skill.name: close-automation
skill.description: Use Rube MCP to automate Close CRM lead, call, SMS, task, note, and call deletion workflows with current schema checks.
skill.summary: Guides Close CRM automation through Rube MCP with safe ID handling and current tool schemas.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most static external command and system reconnaissance findings are false positives from Markdown formatting, Close tool names, and CRM identifiers. The real risks are the disclosed Rube MCP network dependency and business workflows that can send SMS messages or permanently delete call records.

remediation.issue: Third-party MCP endpoint handles Close CRM workflows.
remediation.suggestion: Document the Rube MCP trust boundary and advise users to verify the endpoint before connecting Close CRM data.
Require explicit user approval, recipient verification, and consent checks before sending outbound SMS messages.
Require explicit confirmation and record the reason before deleting Close call activities.

static_findings.snippet: - Active Close connection via `RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS` with toolkit `close`
- Always call `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` first to get current tool schemas
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
1. Verify Rube MCP is available by confirming `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` responds
1. `CLOSE_CREATE_LEAD` - Create a new lead in Close [Required]
- `contacts`: Array of contact objects associated with the lead
- `custom`: Custom field values as key-value pairs
1. `CLOSE_CREATE_SMS` - Send or log an SMS message [Required]
- `note_id`: ID of the note to retrieve
- `call_id`: ID of the call to delete
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
- lead_id is required; calls must be associated with a lead
- contact_id is optional but recommended for tracking
- lead_id is required for all SMS activities
3. Use lead_id in all activity creation calls
1. Identify the lead_id and optionally contact_id
2. Create the activity (call, SMS, note) with lead_id

content.value_statement: Sales teams lose time switching between CRM tasks and tool schemas. This skill guides Close CRM actions through Rube MCP with current schemas and safer ID handling.
actual_capabilities: Checks Rube MCP tool schemas before Close CRM actions.
Creates Close leads with contacts, custom fields, and status IDs.
Logs calls with lead IDs, contact IDs, direction, status, duration, and notes.
Sends or logs SMS messages linked to Close leads and contacts.
Creates follow-up tasks with due dates and assignees.
Retrieves notes and deletes Close call activities when given valid IDs.
limitations: Requires Rube MCP and an active Close connection.
Depends on the user's Close permissions and configured phone features.
Does not perform automatic duplicate lead detection.

use_cases.title: Create Sales Leads
use_cases.description: Create company leads with contact details, custom fields, and correct status IDs after checking the current tool schema.

use_cases.title: Log Outreach Activity
use_cases.description: Record calls, SMS messages, notes, and follow-up tasks against the correct Close lead and contact.

use_cases.title: Maintain CRM Data Quality
use_cases.description: Resolve Close object IDs, avoid common data model errors, and remove incorrect call records with approval.

prompt_templates.title: Create a New Lead
prompt_templates.prompt: Search the Rube Close tools first. Create a Close lead for this company with these contacts, status, and custom fields.

prompt_templates.title: Log a Sales Call
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the correct lead and contact IDs. Log this outbound call with the status, duration, notes, and any follow-up task.

prompt_templates.title: Send a Follow-Up SMS
prompt_templates.prompt: Confirm the recipient and message text with me. Then send or log the SMS in Close and create a follow-up task.

prompt_templates.title: Review and Clean Activity Data
prompt_templates.prompt: Resolve the lead, contact, note, and call IDs. Identify the incorrect call record and ask for confirmation before deletion.

output_examples.input: Create a lead for Acme with two contacts and a qualified status.
output_examples.output: The assistant checks the current schema, asks for missing fields, then creates the Close lead with contacts and status.

output_examples.input: Log a completed outbound call and create a follow-up task for tomorrow.
output_examples.output: The assistant records the call details on the correct lead and creates a dated follow-up task for the assigned user.

output_examples.input: Delete the duplicate call record with this call ID.
output_examples.output: The assistant verifies the call ID, explains that deletion is permanent, and waits for explicit approval before deleting it.

best_practices: Search Rube tools before each workflow to confirm current schemas.
Verify lead, contact, note, and call IDs before changing CRM data.
Request explicit approval before outbound SMS messages or permanent deletion.
anti_patterns: Creating leads before checking for duplicates in Close.
Using display names where Close requires API IDs.
Sending SMS messages or deleting calls without user confirmation.

faq.question: What tools does this skill require?
faq.answer: It requires Rube MCP and an active Close connection through the Close toolkit.

faq.question: Can it create Close leads?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide lead creation with contacts, custom fields, and status IDs.

faq.question: Can it send SMS messages?
faq.answer: Yes, when Close SMS features are configured and the user confirms the recipient and message.

faq.question: Can deleted call records be restored?
faq.answer: No. The skill documentation states that deleting a call is permanent.

faq.question: Does it know current Rube tool schemas?
faq.answer: It instructs the assistant to search Rube tools first so current schemas are used.

faq.question: Does it replace CRM governance?
faq.answer: No. Users still need permission controls, consent checks, and review for sensitive actions.
